newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Lung Kee unit gets Singapore listing OK.
newsitem.headline: Lung Kee unit gets Singapore listing OK.

text.p: Lung Kee (Bermuda) Holdings Ltd's unit, Lung Kee Metal Holdings (LKMH), has received approval in principle from the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES) for a primary main board listing, LKMH said on Wednesday.
LKMH is primarily engaged in design and manufacture of mould bases for making moulds used in plastic injection moulding.
It said in a statement LKMH planned a combined public offering and private placement, but gave no further details.
The proceeds would be used to expand operations in China and Southeast Asia, and to penetrate new markets in Europe, it said.
LKMH's turnover for the year ended March 31, 1996 was Hong Kong $325.8 million and pre-tax profit was HK$91.2 million.
